verdict.rationale: dlt pipelines are Python code (inherently git-versionable) and dltHub provides run logging/auditability and monitoring/log inspection for review, but there is no documented rollback mechanism for pipeline runs or automations, nor an explicit versioning/rollback feature beyond schema evolution. missing for 10: explicit rollback/undo of pipeline runs, native version-history UI, and independent confirmation of version/rollback workflows.
